name: Soyuz MS-25
about: Soyuz MS-25 (2024-055A), a crewed vehicle (Soyuz MS), launched 2024 Mar 23. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2024 Mar 23), held fixed
docked to A09906; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
